description: This file defines the CandidateService class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains constants related to candidate actions and application statuses, a mapping of workflow states, and a method to obtain a CandidateDao instance for database interactions related to candidates.

classes.name: CandidateService
classes.description: Service class providing functionality related to candidates in the recruitment module, including constants for actions and statuses, and access to the CandidateDao.

methods.name: getCandidateDao
methods.description: Retrieves the CandidateDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.
